name: farmxp-browser
description: A browser-based farming simulation game built with vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas.

scripts.build:win: bun run gen-embedded && bun build --compile ./app.ts --outfile dist/FarmingXP --windows-hide-console --windows-icon=icon.ico --windows-title="Farming XP" --windows-publisher="Farming XP" --windows-version=1.0.0.0 --windows-description="Farming XP" && bun tools/hide-console.mjs dist/FarmingXP.exe
scripts.build:linux: bun run gen-embedded && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./app.ts --outfile dist-linux/FarmingXP
scripts.build:server: bun run gen-embedded && bun build --compile ./serve.ts --outfile dist-steam/farmxp-server --windows-hide-console --windows-title="Farming XP Server" --windows-publisher="Farming XP" --windows-version=1.0.0.0 && bun tools/hide-console.mjs dist-steam/farmxp-server.exe
